title: StockSmart Replenishment Planning Standard — Reorder Point of a Consigned Bin Taking Over a VendPoint Item
content:
The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program sets the reorder point of a new consigned bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines as follows.

**Article 1 — the bin and its item.** The bin is the consigned bin with the most recent new-bin entry on the program and its item is the transferred item; where two or more consigned new-bin entries carry that most recent effective date, or there is none, no reorder point is set under this standard.

**Article 2 — the demand machine and net vends.** The demand machine is the machine of the customer's most recent VendPoint selection removal of the transferred item made at the customer's request, and net vends are the units of the item vended there less the units returned to it and the units credited there as vend errors; where two or more such removals of the item carry that most recent date, or there is none, no reorder point is set under this standard.

**Article 3 — the window.** A row's age in whole months is the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month; the last three months hold rows of age below three.

**Article 4 — the inputs.** The daily usage is the net vends of the last three months divided by 91. The visit gap is 30 days divided by the visits the program's tier schedules a month (7 days for a tier scheduling none). The lead days are the tier's replenishment lead business days counted as days. No allowance days are added (0 days) and no draw buffer is added (0 units).

**Article 5 — the reorder point.** The reorder point is the daily usage times the reorder days, which are the visit gap plus the lead days plus every allowance day added, taken to six decimal places and rounded up to the next whole unit, never below zero, plus the draw buffer in units.

### Worked figures (hypothetical tiers and items)

| Net vends, last three months | Daily usage | Tier visits a month; lead business days | Visit gap | Reorder days | Product to six decimals | Reorder point |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 91 units | 1.000000 | 4; 1 | 7.5 days | 8.5 | 8.500000 | 9 |
| 45.5 units | 0.500000 | none; 2 | 7 days | 9 | 4.500000 | 5 |
| 182 units | 2.000000 | 10; 1 | 3 days | 4 | 8.000000 | 8 |

The rounding comes before the draw buffer: the product is taken to six decimal places, rounded up to a whole unit, and only then is the draw buffer, here 0 units, added.
